scope: Actual published default TypeScript Temporal namespace versus temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 basic ISO/Gregorian implementation and @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1. Same 48 public workloads retained from previous facade benchmark. TS uses compact ICU4X lunisolar arithmetic/data, host Intl Umm al-Qura and named timezones. ISO date and zoned cases; no non-ISO throughput claim. Hot operations exclude startup. Selected profiles allow independent fresh processes. No native backend installed.
method: Three fresh sequential processes: default pure TS, temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 basic ISO/Gregorian, @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1. Same 48 public workloads, eight varying inputs/parity. 20000 warmup, 9x50000 calls; transitions 1000 warmup,9x5000. No profiler or native backend. Full sample arrays, exact runtime versions and sizes retained. Native Rust uses a separate matched 25-workload matrix; this comparison does not measure native bindings.
changes: Temporal WASM removed; pure TS runtime source unchanged.
